items.title: Terms of use
items.subtitle: Tickets, bookings and payments
items.bodyMarkdown:
## Tickets and bookings

A ticket or booking is valid for the date and time shown. Tickets are personal to the bearer and may be scanned once per entry.

## Payments

Online payments are processed by our payment partner. Prices are in Nigerian Naira (NGN).

## Cancellations

Cancellations and rescheduling follow the policy shown on your booking at the time of purchase.

## Privacy

We store the details you give us to run your booking and, only if you opt in, to send news and offers. You can unsubscribe at any time.

*This is demo text for the development environment and must be replaced with your approved terms before launch.*

items.title: House rules
items.subtitle: Keeping the resort safe and fun for everyone
items.bodyMarkdown:
## Before you arrive

1. Bring your QR ticket or booking confirmation.
2. Children under 12 must be with an adult at the pool and courts.

## On site

- Swimwear only in the pool; shower before you swim.
- No glass in the pool area.
- Outside food and drinks are not permitted.
- Proper sports shoes on tennis and basketball courts.
- Respect other guests and staff. Management may ask anyone to leave for unsafe or abusive behaviour.

## Safety

Lifeguards are on duty during opening hours. Follow staff instructions at all times.

items.title: About 007 Resort & Spa
items.subtitle: Sport, water, food and rest in one place

hero.alt: Resort hotel wing glowing with warm balcony lights above a landscaped pool at blue-hour dusk

items.bodyMarkdown:
## Play. Splash. Reset. Feast.

007 Resort & Spa was built for the kind of weekend where everyone in the group gets what they want. Some of you want a floodlit game, some want a quiet hour by the water, and somebody always wants a second plate of jollof.

On one property you will find:

- a **sports arena** with football, basketball and tennis courts
- a **resort pool** with loungers, kids' areas and a poolside bar
- a **spa** for massages, facials, sauna and steam
- a **restaurant and bars** serving grills, fresh fish and cocktails

### Made for groups

Families, teams, colleagues and friends book together and pay once. Everything is scanned at the gate with a QR ticket, so there is no queue at the desk.

### Find us

We are in Otueke, Bayelsa State. See the contact page for directions and opening hours.
